title: Sailing, the Marine Hospital and travels in the northern states
summary: Nash recalls sailing on ships, two months in the Marine Hospital after operations, and places he visited from New Haven to San Francisco.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: I mean, it made it nice out there. People seem to be so friendly in Toastable, you know. Where I was. Where was I? In New Haven? No. I was in New Haven. I was in New Haven too. I used to sail on a ship from North of New Haven. I was telling her after I got off the ship, I stayed in the Marine Hospital around about two months. I had an operation, two operations. I went up to New York State. I was out there around in San Francisco, New York. Buffalo. I was in Sterling, Binghamton, Albany, Rochester.
